page.title: Teams
page.description: Who can see and change which projects. Each team owns its projects, their environments, apps and databases.
page.empty: You are not in any team yet. Ask a team admin for an invite link.
page.defaultHint: The default team is the instance itself. Instance admins manage its members on the Users page and here.

banner.title: Everyone is in the default team
banner.body: Create a team to give a group its own projects, environments, apps and databases, with its own owners and members.

roles.ownerHint: Everything, including deleting the team and transferring ownership.
roles.adminHint: Deploys anywhere, including protected environments, and manages members.
roles.developerHint: Deploys, edits env vars and reads logs, except in protected environments.
roles.viewerHint: Reads apps, databases and logs. Changes nothing.

members.title: Members
members.name: Name
members.transferred: Ownership transferred. You are now an admin.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.emailHint: Leave empty for a single use link anyone holding it can redeem.
invites.created: Invite created. Copy the link now, it is not shown again.

forbidden.title: You do not have access here
forbidden.body: Your current team role does not allow this, or it belongs to another team.

accept.title: Join a team
accept.description: You were invited to join a team.
accept.signedInHint: You are signed in, so the invite joins your current account.
accept.newAccountHint: No account yet? Create one here. It belongs to this team only.
accept.name: Display name (optional)
accept.invalid: This invite is invalid, expired, revoked or already used. Ask the team admin for a new one.
accept.missing: This link has no invite token.

quota.title: Quotas
quota.teamHint: Limits for everything filed under this team. A change that would go past a limit is refused with the limit and current usage.
quota.projectHint: Limits for everything filed under this project, on top of any team limits.
quota.editHint: 0 means unlimited. Existing resources are never stopped when a limit is lowered.
quota.readOnly: Only team admins and owners can change these limits.
